courses.title: Introduction to Computer Science & Python
courses.syllabus: Fundamental concepts of programming, algorithms, data structures, variables, loops, functions, object-oriented design, and problem solving in Python.

courses.title: Data Structures & Algorithms
courses.syllabus: Arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, graphs, hashing, sorting algorithms, dynamic programming, and asymptotic complexity analysis (Big-O).

courses.title: Database Management Systems
courses.syllabus: Relational database design, ER diagrams, SQL querying, normalization (1NF to BCNF), indexing, transaction processing, and introduction to NoSQL databases.

courses.title: Foundations of Data Science & Machine Learning
courses.syllabus: Exploratory data analysis, Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, regression models, classification, clustering, evaluation metrics, and ethical AI overview.

courses.title: Calculus & Linear Algebra for Engineers
courses.syllabus: Limits, derivatives, integration, matrices, vector spaces, eigenvalues, eigenvectors, and application of linear algebra to data science.

courses.title: Principles of Financial Management
courses.syllabus: Time value of money, risk and return, financial statement analysis, capital budgeting, corporate finance, and valuation techniques.

courses.title: Artificial Intelligence & Conversational Agents
courses.syllabus: Natural language processing, transformer architectures, LLMs, RAG systems, prompt engineering, agentic workflows, and ethical AI guardrails.
